items.title: Show HN: BlazeRules – YAML rule engine for streaming data, upto 5M records/SEC
items.contentSnippet:
https://github.com/purijs/blazerules
I initially wanted to make a sub-millisecond log parser in C++ but that blew into a embeddable decision engine, that can run YAML defined rules on incoming data.
The rules are executed in a vectorized format on incoming data by reprojecting into a columnar format first, if it's not already. items.contentSnippet:

items.title: The browser is where attacks land. Why is security still focused on the endpoint?
items.contentSnippet:
Presented by CloudMosa
